/**
 * @fileoverview Delegated mouse/touch/keyboard handling (issue #10): one
 * listener set per container instead of ~12 listeners on every row element.
 * Bar and cell elements carry data-task-id (cells also data-column-id), rows
 * carry data-task-row; events are resolved with closest() and re-emitted on
 * the event bus with the same payloads the per-element handlers used.
 * mouseenter/mouseleave do not bubble - they are synthesized from delegated
 * mouseover/mouseout with relatedTarget containment checks.
 * @license MIT
 * @package GanttElastic
 */

/**
 * @fileoverview HTML sanitization for user-supplied task data
 * @license MIT
 * @package GanttElastic
 */

/**
 * @fileoverview Styles for gantt-elastic
 * @license MIT
 * @author Rafal Pospiech <neuronet.io@gmail.com>
 * @package GanttElastic
 */

/**
 * @fileoverview Task mixin
 * @license MIT
 * @author Rafal Pospiech <neuronet.io@gmail.com>
 * @package GanttElastic
 */

/**
 * @fileoverview Task model: normalization of user-supplied task fields and
 * derivation of time fields from patches. The single source of truth for
 * "what a task's canonical time fields are" - previously three divergent
 * copies lived in GanttElastic.vue (fillTasks, applyTaskPatch), Task.mixin
 * and Tooltip.
 * @license MIT
 * @package GanttElastic
 */

/**
 * @fileoverview Time-scale math: chart time window, pixel-per-time scale and
 * day steps. Pure functions over a plain `times` object (the shape of
 * `options.times`) so the highest-risk math in the chart is testable
 * without mounting the component.
 * @license MIT
 * @package GanttElastic
 */
